what: Badger TTK estimator — batch grades over real Warcraft Logs corpora (learning-how-to-learn phase). Raw corpora are local-only (gitignored); this file is the curated outcome.

runs.corpus: Fresh MC ×10 · BWL ×8 · AQ ×2 — 126 kills, each raid from its own relevance window
runs.label: MC+BWL+AQ ×126

runs.corpus: Lucifron ×20, frozen (the human's hunt) — rhythm learned from the same 20 (mechanism proof; validation on fresh kills next loop)
runs.label: loop 1: rhythm

runs.estimator: rhythm candidate, retrained (loop 2) — profile from 25-kill TRAIN half
runs.corpus: Lucifron ×50 — graded on the HELD-OUT 25 (train/test split; fresh-30 view: 38.7%→26.9%, 25/30 better)
runs.label: loop 2: validated

compare.note: train≈test → no overfitting; profile stable across retrains

runs.estimator: rhythm candidate — Magmadar profile from 25-kill TRAIN half (loop 3)
runs.corpus: Magmadar ×50 — graded on the HELD-OUT 25 (train/test split)
runs.label: loop 3: Magmadar

compare.note: second encounter, different shape (Frenzy slow-phase), bigger win

runs.corpus: Gehennas ×50 — graded on the HELD-OUT 25 (train/test split)
runs.label: loop 4: Gehennas

compare.note: largest absolute drop yet (-21.6pp); test beats train
